title: Deep Within the Ruins
next_chapter_hook: When the Guardian's Residual Soul revealed the truth sealed away ten thousand years ago, Chen Ji realized that from the very beginning, he had always been merely a piece on a vast chessboard, not yet placed.

text.content: At the moment of stepping into the ruins, Chen Ji felt the pressure around him surge, as if invisible giant hands were clutching him. Surrounding him stretched endless ancient paths of blue stone, with cryptic runes carved on both stone walls, faintly glowing with an eerie blue light like eyes沉睡万载，正缓缓睁开。 The air was filled with an indescribable aura—not decay, but a kind of solemnity frozen by time. Chen Ji's steps faltered slightly; the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms grew faintly hot, as if warning him of something. He raised his head to look— at the end of the ancient path, a massive stone gate stood quietly, with three ancient seal characters on the lintel barely visible in the dim light—「Chen Xuan Tomb」.

At that moment, the runes on the stone gate suddenly lit up, and dazzling light enveloped Chen Ji. His pupils contracted sharply; somewhere dormant within his body, a bloodline that had been silent for ages began to seethe on its own, like ten thousand horses galloping, like a thousand armies shouting. It was a resonance from the depths of his bloodline! Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his hands—on both palms emerged two symmetrical ancient marks—one crimson as fire, the other pitch-black as ink. Where red intertwined with black, a vast and mournful aura rushed toward him. These marks... why did they feel so familiar? He suddenly remembered the passage recorded on the Tianji Record Fragment: 「Ten thousand years ago, the bloodline served as the guide to forge the vessel of Heavenly Secrets.」

dialogue.content: ...You've finally arrived. The voice was aged and distant, as if traveling from ancient primordial times, echoing endlessly through the spacious stone passage. Chen Ji's heart lurched; he turned sharply, only to find a illusory figure had appeared behind him. It was an old man with white hair and beard, wearing a dated Taoist robe, surrounded by faint golden motes of light. His features were indistinct, but his eyes were clear—deep, compassionate, yet carrying a cold indifference that surveyed all things.

This old one has waited twelve thousand years. The Guardian's Residual Soul stepped forward slowly; with each step, Chen Ji felt the pressure multiply. That resonance from the depths of his bloodline grew ever stronger, nearly overwhelming his rational defenses. 「Chen family bloodline, inheriting Heavenly Fate...」 The old man stopped three zhang away, his world-penetrating gaze lingering briefly on the marks in Chen Ji's palms, 「...but tell me, what have you inherited—Heavenly Fate, or the name of a sacrifice?」

text.content: Sacrifice? Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his expression on the surface still calm, only the fists subtly tightening in his sleeves revealing a few clues. Twelve thousand years—for mortals an unimaginable length, yet for someone who could peer three hours into the future within Heavenly Secrets, it was merely the accumulation of countless calculations. He should have foreseen this. The origin of the Tianji Record Fragment, the rules governing Heavenly Fate consumption, the triggers for bloodline awakening—none of it had ever truly been honest with him. He thought he was the chess player, only to discover that perhaps from the beginning, he had merely been the most crucial piece on the chessboard. And a piece has no need to know who the player is.

dialogue.content: Twelve thousand years ago, the Chen family progenitor, using his own body as the guide and bloodline as the covenant, sealed the Tianji Record Fragment here. The Guardian's Residual Soul raised his illusory palm, pointing to that stone gate: 「His sacrifice bought the human race ten thousand years of respite. But what he did not know was—」 The old man's voice suddenly dropped, carrying an inexplicable mockery: 「The Tianji Record itself is the eye of Heavenly Dao. And your Chen family bloodline is merely... sustenance fed to this eye.」

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing. The runes on the stone walls continued to flicker with blue light, and those lights now appeared almost like the shape of pupils. Ten thousand years ago, bloodline as the guide to forge the vessel of Heavenly Secrets—he once believed this was glory, inheritance, the supreme merit of the Chen family ancestors. Now he understood it was merely another form of sacrifice. His palms trembled slightly; the marks burned like fire, and he could faintly sense some will sealed within stirring toward awakening. That was a summons from the depths of his bloodline, also an echo of that sacrifice ten thousand years ago. 「So...」 he finally spoke, his voice unusually calm, 「my presence here is no coincidence.」

dialogue.content: Naturally not. The Guardian's Residual Soul gave a slight nod, a complex glint flashing in his eyes: 「The Tianji Record chose you, the eye of Heavenly Dao watches you, the bloodline marks from ten thousand years ago call to you—」 「You thought it was fortune, but it is actually reincarnation.」 The old man took a step forward; golden light suddenly gathered around him, forming an illusory chain: 「Chen family bloodline passes down through generations, and each generation awakens part of the marks. But only the most compatible one truly steps here.」 「And your arrival means—」 He paused; in those world-penetrating eyes, a trace of emotion Chen Ji couldn't comprehend actually appeared.

text.content: Chen Ji watched that illusory chain quietly. Golden light danced through the stone passage, stretching and compressing their shadows. The Guardian's Residual Soul's words were like blade after blade, peeling away the truths he thought he knew, revealing the unimaginable face beneath. He was the wielder of the Tianji Record, the prophet who could see three hours into the future, the discarded disciple who plotted the world with flawless calculations. Yet above all this, there was another identity—the continuing vessel of a sacrifice from ten thousand years ago. In other words, his very existence was the unfinished final step of that sacrifice. The marks on his palms burned hotter, as if to char his flesh to ash. And in his mind, the Tianji Record Fragment flipped uncontrollably, rustling as if something was trying to break through the pages.

dialogue.content: You are the last one. The Guardian's Residual Soul's voice was low and desolate: 「Over ten thousand years, Chen family bloodline was passed down single file, each awakening descendant coming here to accept the final awakening of the sacrifice marks. After awakening—」 He raised his hand, pointing to the 「Chen Xuan Tomb」 stone gate: 「Their Heavenly Fate would be completely absorbed by the Tianji Record, becoming nourishment to fill the eye of Heavenly Dao. The body perishes, the soul scatters, bloodline passes to the next generation, then the cycle repeats.」 「You thought you were consuming Heavenly Fate to use the power of Heavenly Secrets?」 The old man sneered, 「No, you were merely proving to the eye of Heavenly Dao that you still have value worth harvesting.」

text.content: The stone passage fell into dead silence. Chen Ji lowered his eyes, hiding the storm churning in his pupils. He remembered when the Tianji Record Fragment first recognized its master, the inexplicable emptiness with each consumption of Heavenly Fate, the tragedies he had seen in Heavenly Secrets yet could not change— So the futures he saw were never things he 「saw,」 but things he was 「allowed」 to see. He thought he had flawless calculations, but in truth, he had merely been deceiving himself within the boundaries set by Heavenly Dao. The marks on his palms jumped suddenly; a stream of information forcibly flooded his mind—fragments of that sacrifice scene from ten thousand years ago: amidst blood-colored light filling the sky, a man bound by chains stood on the altar, smiling, dividing his bloodline in two and injecting it into two jade slips. One became today's Tianji Record. The other...

Where did the other one go? The moment this thought arose in Chen Ji's mind, the answer emerged on its own—within his bloodline. The Chen family progenitor from ten thousand years ago had sealed half of his original soul into his descendants' bloodline, meaning every generation of Chen family members carried fragments of his soul. The Tianji Record was the other part he left behind, used to guide bloodline inheritance and await the appearance of the 「most compatible」 inheritor. Then, to take everything back. Chen Ji raised his head sharply, his gaze toward the Guardian's Residual Soul suddenly sharp: 「So what are you? Guardian of遗志, or accomplice to the executioner?」

dialogue.content: This old one? The Guardian's Residual Soul let out an ambiguous laugh: 「This old one is merely a residual soul, the last thread of obsession left by the progenitor. You ask if I am guardian or accomplice—」 He spread his arms, letting golden light flow around him: 「I do not know.」 「I only know my mission is to wait, to wait for the one who can complete the sacrifice.」 The old man's voice suddenly rose: 「Over ten thousand years, I have seen too many Chen family descendants walk in. Some went to their deaths heroically, some resisted desperately, some even tried to destroy the Tianji Record—」 「But the outcome has never changed.」 He gazed deeply at Chen Ji: 「What will you do?」

choice.prompt: Facing the Guardian's Residual Soul's questioning, the truth from ten thousand years ago pressing down like a boulder, what is your choice?

choices.description: Since the marks from ten thousand years ago are already inscribed in the bloodline, I shall inherit this power, actively awakening the complete sacrifice marks. If fate demands I be a sacrifice, then I will first take its benefits.
choices.visible_cost: This will accelerate Heavenly Fate consumption; the sacrifice countdown begins
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the 「Bloodline Resonance」 ability, allowing temporary borrowing of sacrifice power; combat power temporarily increases by two realms
choices.risk_hint: The awakening cost is becoming the complete harvest target of the Heavenly Dao's eye

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly raising both hands. Under stimulation, the palm marks erupted with dazzling red-black intertwined light; a powerful force surged from the depths of his bloodline, racing through meridians into all four limbs and hundred pores. He felt his perception rapidly expanding—not only could he see three hours into the future, but he could also faintly touch the... will shrouding Heavenly Secrets. That was the Heavenly Dao's eye. It was watching him.

text.content: The Guardian's Residual Soul gave a slight nod: 「You made the same choice as your predecessors—first take its benefits, then bear its consequences.」 「But remember,」 his figure began to fade, 「your time is shorter than theirs.」 Golden light dissipated; Chen Ji stood alone in the stone passage, the marks on his palms having increased from two to four, layered like shackles branded on the soul. And his Tianji Record Fragment was flipping madly, the originally blurry content on its pages becoming clear piece by piece...

dialogue.content: At that moment, a cold and vast consciousness pierced through the void, pressing directly into Chen Ji's mind: 「You have finally arrived.」 That voice carried no emotion, yet was more terrifying than any threat. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that was the Heavenly Dao's eye; he could clearly sense it was examining him, evaluating him, calculating his 「value.」 And what chilled him more was that under its gaze, he actually felt a trace of... familiarity. As if he had seen these eyes before.

text.content: The Heavenly Dao's eye's consciousness receded like the tide, but the feeling of being watched lingered long after. Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the four marks on his palms, discovering that the third one... was exactly the same as a pattern he had seen in a certain prophecy fragment. It was an inverted eye. And the time that prophecy fragment showed was precisely—three years ago, the night he first activated the Tianji Record Fragment. 「So that's how it is.」 he murmured to himself, a self-mocking glint flickering in his eyes, 「So from the very beginning, I was right under its nose.」

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji clenched his fist, his knuckles turning white.

He recalled what Mo Xiansheng once said: "Each page of knowledge corresponds to a phase of unsealing." At the time, he thought it was a rule of the Tianji Record, but now he realized it was merely bait from the Heavenly Eye, guiding him step by step toward awakening.

The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of fate—this sentence was never a warning, but a... promise.

But Chen Ji was never one to accept his fate.

"Since you gave me this power," he raised his head, staring directly at an invisible point in the void, "I will use this power—to overturn your chessboard."

choices.description: My fate is controlled by me, not by Heaven! The mark in my bloodline is merely a shackle forcibly imposed upon me. I will use the power of Heavenly Secrets to reverse fate, breaking free from this ten-thousand-year cycle of curses.
choices.visible_cost: Will suffer the backlash of the sacrificial mark, Heavenly Fate value rapidly depleting
choices.visible_reward: Unlocked hidden achievement 'Destiny Defier', obtained one-time item 'Bloodline Shackles' — can seal one's own bloodline mark for one hour
choices.risk_hint: During the backlash period, Combat Power will decrease by half, and one will be marked as a priority target by the Heavenly Eye

dialogue.content:
"I don't believe in fate."

Chen Ji violently activated the Tianji Record Fragment, and a force utterly opposite to the bloodline mark surged forth from the fragment. That was the power of prophecy, the Heavenly Secrets path he had exchanged countless Heavenly Fate values for.

The two forces collided violently within his body, as incompatible as fire and water, like arch-nemeses confronting each other. Chen Ji's complexion instantly turned deathly pale, a mouthful of blood nearly spouting out, but he forcibly swallowed it back.

"Since you want to make me a sacrifice—" he gritted his teeth, speaking word by word, "I will smash this sacrifice first!"

text.content:
The mark in his palm violently throbbed, as if trying to break through his flesh. The text on the Tianji Record Fragment疯狂闪烁, the originally clear prophetic ability becoming fragmented.

Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate value depleting visibly to the naked eye—not a consumption of five points each time, but ten, twenty, thirty points... The sacrificial mark was going into mad backlash, punishing his rebellion.

But at the same time, a stream of information再次涌入他的脑海—这一次, not from the sacrificial mark, but from the Tianji Record itself.

That was a line of text that had never appeared before: "Ten thousand years ago, when the ancestor divided his soul, he left behind a backdoor."

dialogue.content:
The guardian's remnant soul figure coalesced once more in the golden light, and this time, his features were several degrees clearer.

"You are indeed different from them." The old man's voice carried a trace of relief: "For ten thousand years, you are the first person to dare deny fate to my face."

He raised his hand, pointing to the stone gate of "Chen Xuan's Tomb": "The backdoor is right there. The ancestor left a trump card back then—"

"He divided the core of the Tianji Record into two halves. One half is prophetic power, the other half..." The old man paused: "Is the key to severing the shackles of fate."

"And that key will only appear when the bloodline mark is denied."

text.content:
The stone door slowly opened, a breath of ten-thousand-year-old air rushing toward him. Chen Ji endured the violent pain in his body and stumbled inside.

Behind the door was a modest stone chamber, its walls covered with densely packed runes. In the center, on a stone platform, two items were placed—

A pitch-black Jade Slip, and a golden chain.

Chen Ji's gaze fell on that chain, and he instantly understood its purpose—that was the "Bloodline Shackles," which could temporarily seal the sacrificial mark's effect.

And that Jade Slip...

He reached out to touch it, and another stream of information flooded into his mind: "This is the Path-Severing Chapter. When cultivated to great completion, it can sever all predestined causes and effects."

"Including—the Heavenly Eye's gaze upon you."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji tucked both items into his chest, about to turn and leave, when a cold voice suddenly rang out in the chamber:

"Interesting."

That voice was different from before, not coming from the guardian's remnant soul, but from... the Void.

Chen Ji's hair stood on end as he猛然抬头. He knew who it was—

The Heavenly Eye.

"For ten thousand years, you are the first Chen bloodline to dare deny fate." That voice actually carried a hint of amusement: "This one is very curious—"

"How far can you go?"

Before the words even finished, a world-destroying pressure suddenly descended. Chen Ji's body was forced to kneel, the sound of his knees striking the stone floor echoing in the chamber.

But he still raised his head, stubbornly gazing at the invisible existence in the void.

choices.description: I will not make preconceived judgments. I must first understand the truth of ten thousand years ago—why did the ancestor sacrifice himself? What exactly is the Heavenly Eye? I want all the answers.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming additional Heavenly Fate value to activate 'Eye of Heavenly Secrets' to directly gaze upon the past
choices.visible_reward: Unlocked hidden storyline 'The Truth of Ten Thousand Years Ago', can peer into the full picture of the sacrificial ritual
choices.risk_hint: Gazing upon the past will expose Chen Ji's location to the Heavenly Eye, and may trigger unknown timeline fluctuations

dialogue.content:
"Wait."

Chen Ji did not accept, nor did he refuse. His voice was unusually calm, yet carried an unshakable determination:

"You speak of sacrifice, of reincarnation, of the Heavenly Eye—but what exactly happened ten thousand years ago? Why did the ancestor do this? And what exactly is the Heavenly Eye?"

He stared directly into the guardian's remnant soul's deep eyes: "I want the truth, the complete truth."

"Not filtered fragments, not just the parts you are willing to tell me—but everything."

The guardian's remnant soul was silent for a moment.

"Do you know what gazing upon the past means?" The old man's voice was low: "It will consume a massive amount of your Heavenly Fate value, and—"

"And it will expose your location, drawing the Heavenly Eye's attention." Chen Ji picked up the words, the corners of his lips slightly rising: "So what?"

He raised his palm, the mark in his palm slowly glowing under activation: "Since I am to make a choice, I cannot make it without knowing anything."

"Whatever I do, Chen Ji, I always see the entire chess game before making my move."

text.content:
The guardian's remnant soul gazed at him, and after a long while, let out a soft sigh.

"Very well."

The old man waved his hand, and a golden curtain of light unfolded before Chen Ji. That curtain was like a mirror, but what it reflected was not the current scene, but a void of chaos beginning, heaven and earth undifferentiated.

"This is the moment ten thousand years ago." The guardian's remnant soul's voice sounded in his ear: "The Heavenly Eye had just been born, and it needed a vessel to observe the mortal realm, so it chose—"

"The ancestor."

The scene began to flow. Chen Ji saw a young man standing atop the altar, his features bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, but his eyes held more madness and resolve.

That was his ancestor—Chen Jia's first family head, Chen Xuan.

The scene continued to flow.

Chen Ji saw the contract between the Heavenly Eye and Chen Xuan: the Heavenly Eye granted the Chen family prophetic power and cultivation talent, while Chen Xuan promised to leave a mark in the bloodline, generation after generation providing nourishment for the Heavenly Eye.

However, Chen Xuan left a trump card.

In the final moment of sacrifice, he divided his own soul into two halves—one half merged into the Tianji Record, becoming a window for the Heavenly Eye to observe the mortal realm; the other half was sealed into the bloodline, waiting for a descendant among future generations capable of breaking the contract.

"So..." Chen Ji murmured, "The ancestor never truly intended to accept his fate from the beginning."

The guardian's remnant soul slightly nodded: "He believed that eventually, one generation of descendants would be stronger than him, strong enough to overturn this chess game."

dialogue.content:
"But this is not everything."

The guardian's remnant soul's voice suddenly became grave: "The Heavenly Eye is not merely an observation tool. It is... an incarnation of Heavenly Mandate's will."

"Over ten thousand years, it has continuously devoured the Heavenly Fate values of the Chen bloodline, not to satisfy appetite, but to—"

The old man paused. The scene within the golden curtain suddenly changed, reflecting a vast starry sky. Deep within the starry sky, a gaze so enormous it could not be measured slowly opened.

That was not the Heavenly Eye.

That was... the Heavenly Mandate itself.

"It is searching for a vessel capable of bearing its own consciousness." The guardian's remnant soul's voice carried a trace of trembling: "And the Chen bloodline is the most compatible option it has found so far."

"Every generation of awakener is a... candidate vessel it has cultivated in the mortal realm."

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted.

Candidate vessel.

So his identity as "chess player" was always a joke from the beginning. He was not a chess piece—a chess piece at least had its own will—he was... an ingredient.

A cold consciousness suddenly penetrated the void, descending directly upon him.

"Seen it?"

That voice was the same as before, but with an added naked scrutiny: "Now you know, Chen Ji."

"You, I, and this entire world are merely nourishment for the Heavenly Mandate's revival. And you—"

That consciousness seemed to be laughing: "You are the most plump one."

Chen Ji felt all the blood in his body boiling, the mark in his palm疯狂跳动, as if responding to something. He knew it was the Heavenly Eye marking him.

From this moment on, he could no longer hide.

"So what?"

Unexpected to all, Chen Ji actually laughed.

"You want to devour me, but you still need to see if I agree." He raised his head, a sharpness in his eyes completely incompatible with his timid exterior: "Ten thousand years ago, the ancestor could not overturn your chessboard. That doesn't mean I, Chen Ji, cannot."

"I have noted it." he said softly, as if speaking to himself, or as if making a declaration to that lofty consciousness: "From the moment you personally told me the truth, you are no longer an unknowable existence."

"What can be known can be defeated."
